steps: Fee challans are issued by the Fee Counter of the Accounts Office.

aliases: challan; fee challan; fee voucher; challan kahan se milega; payment; pay fee; bank; banking app
steps: Payment can be made at the Bank of Punjab booth near Gate 1, at a bank branch, in cash, or through a banking app.

documents: A written application to the Dean's Office.
steps: Submit a written application to the Dean's Office. The Dean approves and signs the application. The Fee Counter then issues a corrected challan.

title: Fee challan: If the challan is lost
aliases: challan; fee challan; fee voucher; challan kahan se milega; lost challan; challan gum
steps: If a challan is lost, the Fee Counter issues a new one.

title: Fee installments
aliases: installment; instalment; fee due date; second installment; late fine; fine; last date; fee deadline
deadline: Fees may be paid in two installments, or in a maximum of three. Due dates are stated on the challan and on the signed installment application. A late fine of Rs. 50 per day applies.

title: Hostel allotment
aliases: hostel; hostel admission; hostel room; hostel documents; hostel fee; hostel ke documents
documents: The student's CNIC (or B-Form if under 18), the father's CNIC, permanent address details, and the Matric result card (intermediate students), Intermediate result card (undergraduate students) or transcript (graduate students).
steps: Hostel accommodation is for students who have secured admission to intermediate, undergraduate or graduate programmes and who live outside Lahore. Students apply at the time of admission. Applicants are interviewed, and students are then selected for the hostel. A student who is not allotted a hostel at the first attempt may submit an application to the Principal.
deadline: Applications are made at the time of admission. For hostel fee details and any changes or updates, please contact the Finance Office.

title: Transcript application
aliases: transcript; transcript kaise banwayen; degree transcript
documents: A written application and clearance of all outstanding dues.
steps: Apply at the Registrar Office with a written application and clearance of all outstanding dues. Processing takes a minimum of one week.
deadline: Processing time: a minimum of one week.

title: Character certificate
documents: An application signed by the Head of Department.
steps: Submit an application signed by your Head of Department at the Registrar Office.

title: Medical emergency

steps: In a medical emergency, go to the Health Room.

title: Course registration and timetable
aliases: registration; course registration; timetable; time table; class schedule; add drop; CMS; spring registration; fall registration
office: Admissions Office (for registration deadlines, problems and add/drop dates)
steps: Registration opens at the start of each semester and closes within 10 days. Students register through their CMS portal. The timetable is published on each student's CMS portal.
deadline: Fall semester registration closed on 28 August 2026. For spring semester registration deadlines, please contact the Admissions Office.
